    Create a patient card

    Source: R/patient-card.R
    sdt_patient_card.Rd

    Constructs a single validated patient_card describing one casualty in a mass-casualty scenario. Fields follow the TDSC tabletop patient-card model.

    Usage

    sdt_patient_card(
  id,
  age,
  sex,
  life_points,
  ventilated,
  injury_region,
  triage,
  therapy,
  arrival_order
)

    Arguments

    id

    Character scalar identifier for the casualty.

    age

    Whole number, patient age in years.

    sex

    One of "f", "m", "d".

    life_points

    Whole number in 1:6; lower is more critical.

    ventilated

    Logical; whether the casualty requires ventilation.

    injury_region

    Leading injury region; one of sdt_injury_regions().

    triage

    True sighting category; one of sdt_triage_levels().

    therapy

    True therapy concept; one of sdt_therapy_levels().

    arrival_order

    Whole number giving position in the arrival sequence.

    Value

    An S3 object of class patient_card.

    Examples

    sdt_patient_card(
  id = "P01", age = 34, sex = "m", life_points = 4L,
  ventilated = TRUE, injury_region = "thorax",
  triage = "red", therapy = "DCS", arrival_order = 1L
)
